title.narrative: Business procedures for commercial registration of tax payers in the Bureau of Internal Revenue

comment.narrative: Based on IFC survey data. The baseline for the indicator on ITAS business procedures administration was a manual system (11procedures) and it excludes post-registration procedures to validate registered taxpayers and eliminate duplications as well as totrack them.
Automated

A new automation system has 13 procedures including validation and approval of registered taxpayers. The automation has actuallyincreased the number of processes. It incorporates TIN registration as part of a one-stop-shop where all tax registration processesare handled in one location (Business Registry), thus increases effectiveness, i.e. reducing time to go to several offices.
